root_idea.summary: The supplied root analysis centers on دوام: continuing or remaining attached to something.
root_idea.development: Classical usage develops this orientation into persistence, while also associating ثُبَة with a distinct company and with the center of a basin to which water returns. The relation of the basin term to this root is disputed; a derived ثَبَّى also denotes enumerative praise.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The Quranic plural ثُبَات is presented under its supported singular dictionary citation form ثُبَة.

senses.usage_conditions: In the Quran, ثُبَاتٍ is the plural of ثُبَة and describes going forth in separate groups, contrasted with going forth all together.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To persist in or continue doing something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with على for persistence in an undertaking or activity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To praise a person during his lifetime by recounting the person’s merits separately or one by one.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A derived Classical Arabic use involving the enumeration of distinct merits.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A company or band of horsemen.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Classical specialization of the group noun; it is not asserted as a restriction on the Quranic use in 4:71.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The middle or central part of a basin, where the water returns.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The supplied Classical discussion treats this as a distinct lexical use but disputes its derivation: it may be connected with ثبي or with the ثاب/ثوب branch because of the omitted weak radical.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Pointer-only unit: “See ثبو”; it supplies no lexical definition or independently usable meaning.

cautions: The relation of the basin term ثُبَة to the canonical root ثبي is explicitly disputed in the supplied evidence.
The supplied Lane primary material is pointer-only, so the lexical senses rely on the supplied Mufradat and Maqayis evidence.
unassigned_or_ambiguous_evidence: The basin-center meaning is lexically attested, but its root assignment is unresolved: one analysis connects it with ثبي, while another derives it through ثاب/ثوب.
